HADESANCIENTS-TRANQUIL_GAIN.title: Tranquil Gain
HADESANCIENTS-TRANQUIL_GAIN.description: The first time each combat you end your turn with at least [blue]{EnergyThreshold}[/blue] unspent Energy, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional card at the start of each turn for the rest of combat.
HADESANCIENTS-WINTER_HARVEST.title: Winter Harvest
HADESANCIENTS-WINTER_HARVEST.description: Enemies with [blue]{HealthThreshold}%[/blue] Max HP or less shatter at the start of their turn. Whenever a creature shatters, deal damage equal to its Max HP to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-SNOW_QUEEN.title: Snow Queen
HADESANCIENTS-SNOW_QUEEN.description: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{MaxHpLossPercent}%[/blue] Max HP. Start each combat with [blue]{BufferPower}[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold] and [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-FRIGID_RUSH.title: Frigid Rush
HADESANCIENTS-FRIGID_RUSH.description: At the start of each turn, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your draw pile. Whenever you draw a [gold]Status[/gold] card, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
